title.zh: 【美参议员正调查 Tether 向前白宫加密顾问旗下咨询公司支付数百万美元款项事件】
title.en: 【美参议员正调查 Tether 向前白宫加密顾问旗下咨询公司支付数百万美元款项事件】

current_state.zh: Senator Richard Blumenthal is investigating Tether's payments of millions of dollars to Nxum Group, the consultancy of former White House crypto adviser and current Tether US head Bo Hines, and has demanded both parties disclose the arrangement.
